name: frappe-skills-pack
description: A production-ready dual AI skill pack and multi-agent integration hub for the Frappe/ERPNext ecosystem: deep technical knowledge base (frappe-docs) and Arabic course generation engine (frappe-course-generator), compatible with Hermes, Claude, Gemini, Antigravity, OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, and Cline.

skills.name: frappe-docs
skills.description: Comprehensive knowledge of the entire Frappe/ERPNext ecosystem (Frappe Framework, ERPNext, Frappe HR, CRM, Cloud, Builder, Insights, Print Designer, Wiki, Drive, Learning, Helpdesk). Use this skill whenever the user mentions Frappe, ERPNext, bench commands, DocType, frappe.get_doc, frappe.whitelist, frappe.call, frappe.db.sql, ERPNext modules (Accounts/Stock/Selling/Buying/Manufacturing/HR/Projects/Payroll), Web Forms, Server Scripts, Client Scripts, hooks.py, Print Formats, Workflows, Custom Fields, REST API of Frappe/ERPNext, or any task involving installation, customization, troubleshooting, code generation, or configuration of Frappe-based systems.

skills.name: frappe-course-generator
skills.description: Generates complete, production-ready training courses on the Frappe/ERPNext ecosystem in Arabic (with English code/technical terms). Use this skill whenever the user asks to 'create a course', 'build a curriculum', 'generate training material', 'make a tutorial', 'توليد دورة', 'إنشاء كورس تعليمي', 'دورة Frappe', 'دورة ERPNext', 'محتوى تعليمي', 'مواد تدريبية', or wants to teach Frappe/ERPNext to others (developers, end-users, or admins). Also use it when the user wants a 'training kit', 'workshop materials', 'bootcamp', 'onboarding guide', 'learning path', or any structured educational deliverable covering Frappe Framework, ERPNext modules, or any Frappe app.

install.npm: npx skills add https://github.com/Orphic-Studios/frappe-skills --skill frappe-docs && npx skills add https://github.com/Orphic-Studios/frappe-skills --skill frappe-course-generator
